abort_conditions: Smoke (300 s, same host as its control smoke): candidate completes fewer steps than the same-host control smoke (334 trn21 / 335 trn22) -> abort, no throughput gain; do not launch full run.

Smoke: train loss at any matched logged step differs from the same-host control smoke by more than 0.01, or smoke public_val_bpb differs by more than 0.003 at steps within 2% -> abort; the frozen-zero shift is not numerically inert and the hypothesis is falsified.
Any non-finite loss, causality_passed=false, compile failure, or missing final checkpoint -> abort and record as invalid.

Launch environment deviates from the control: NEURON_CC_FLAGS must equal '--optlevel=1' exactly (no autocast additions), NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, nproc 4, --num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42; otherwise the run is void, not a result.
Full run completes more than 10% fewer steps than the same-host control -> CONFOUNDED per protocol section 5, not a quality verdict.

research/experiment-protocol.md section 5: rate comparisons must be back-to-back, same box, same code; quality comparisons need step counts within 10%.
expected_effect: Primary: public_val_bpb decreases by 0.0005 to 0.002 relative to the same-host pinned control (trn21 1.005734 / trn22 1.005967), driven by +1% to +4% more optimizer steps (trn21-matched: 2092-2154 steps; trn22-matched: 2097-2159 steps) with an unchanged per-step trajectory. Classification, evaluated in this precedence order against the same-host control: (1) FALSIFIED-MATH if smoke train loss at matched logged steps differs from the control smoke by more than 0.01 or full-run BPB is worse than control by more than 0.0005 with steps within 10% (the frozen-zero shift is not an identity); (2) FALSIFIED-THROUGHPUT if full-run steps are not greater than the same-host control (<=2071 trn21 / <=2076 trn22); (3) SUCCESS if steps >= control+1% (>=2092 trn21 / >=2097 trn22) and BPB <= control-0.0005; (4) INERT otherwise (steps gain <1% or |dBPB|<0.0005). Official private-shard BPB is expected to move in the same direction as public BPB but is not the predeclared decision metric.
hypothesis: At the pinned default shape the control runs a QK token-shift whose mixing coefficient is frozen at zero (control ledger oneliners: qk_shift=True qk_beta=0.0 qk_freeze=True). Because the coefficient is a frozen parameter tensor rather than a compile-time constant, the compiled graph must still execute the per-layer shift (roll/pad, multiply, add on the q and k activations in all 6 layers, forward and backward) even though beta*shift == 0 exactly and the output equals the unshifted q/k. Passing --no-qk-shift removes that dead work without changing the mathematical function, so the per-step trajectory should be unchanged (within compiler noise) while step time drops. Under the time-based 1800 s schedule (fresh-start runs used --num-steps 1000000 with --max-train-seconds 1800 and still fully annealed; batch-ramp bounds and EMA start_frac are budget fractions), more optimizer steps in the same budget lower val_bpb.
single_causal_change: Pass --no-qk-shift only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: same launch command shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, nproc 4, --num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42), same environment (NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1' exactly, NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42), no precision, kernel, optimizer, schedule, batch, or evaluation change. The only behavioral delta is removal of the frozen-zero QK token-shift branch; --qk-shift-beta/--qk-shift-freeze are not passed.
